digest.component_or_area: coordinated create family, outbound batch dispatch
propositions: Create operations must survive process restart without duplicate remote issues, verified through Cloud/DC crash-restart sequences executed twice with fresh state.

Exactly one route selector (create_route.create_route) must govern create dispatch across all live consumers (route_for, reroute_migrated_plans, handle_create/create_one) with no dual-send and legacy as rollback fallback.
Dependent links and children must be held until create and binding confirmation are proven, while tombstones, filters, and read-only modes remain effective.
Recovery must preserve keyed operations with zero search, keyless operations with three misses and 3600-second timeout, and allow per-ticket recovery failure without blocking unrelated tickets.

Coordinated create core must return identical outcomes to legacy create (success dict, re-raised HTTPError, BRIDGE_ALERT for landed-unconfirmed, deferred append for commit-unknown) through shared prelude/postlude contract.
